title: Bus fires involving Mercedes-Benz Citaro buses and safety checks
asked: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong asked whether LTA investigated the root causes of 2026 bus fires involving Mercedes-Benz Citaro buses, whether additional safety protocols and mechanical audits are being implemented across older public transport fleet assets, and if so what they are.
response: Mr Murali Pillai said LTA investigated and found the Citaro fires were caused by failures of different parts, with no common underlying cause and parts within manufacturer-recommended useful life. LTA directed public bus operators to carry out additional inspections of their Citaro buses, and no abnormalities were found. LTA is working with operators to enhance the bus inspection regime for older buses and assess additional preventive measures. On fire suppression, he confirmed systems are available for the engine compartment but said he did not have specifics at that point.
